cues.text:
A source repair. A booking you can prove.
For developers and accessibility QA reviewing AI-generated patches.

The original date control was a non-focusable div.
Loading the page did not prove the keyboard booking could finish.

Nemotron 3 Super generated these source edits.
The diagnosis and repair direction were supplied. This request is recorded.

Five proposed edits. The date control becomes keyboard-editable.
Review the source before approving execution.

Deferred calendar refreshes can overwrite a typed date.
The stored date must match the requested task.

Clearing the input must be safe.
Reopening the appointment must retain its date and customer data.

Approval binds the displayed patch hash to this execution.
The fixture is fresh, isolated, and synthetic.

cues.tag: FRESH LOCAL EXECUTION / RECORDED MODEL PROPOSAL
cues.text:
The approved proposal enters a new isolated execution.
No new model request is made during this capture.

Trusted setup prepares separate source, app, database, and reader roles.
Candidate execution has no model key or external network.

The patched application is compiled before the keyboard task.
A build pass alone cannot verify the saved outcome.

A fixed native keyboard procedure completes the booking.
Confirmation remains subject to independent outcome checks.

A SELECT-only reader checks storage; a fresh browser reopens the booking.
Pointer booking, unavailable-slot, and preservation checks also run.

The expected booking and regression checks passed for this exact run.
The proposal hash remains attached to its evidence.

November 2, 2026 · 09:00–09:30 Asia/Riyadh.
Storage, fresh reopen, preservation, and regression controls passed.

Two of five frozen attempts passed the full procedure.
Two failed to compile; one failed a calendar control after keyboard success.

One exposed case, with guided source generation.
Broader repair and screen-reader validation remain open.
